title: Zero Net Mon
summary: Network monitor by port: devices, open ports, Wi-Fi security, USB, live traffic.
description:
Zero Net Mon looks at networks through the CardputerZero's own hardware. The home screen has one tile per port (Ethernet, Wi-Fi 2.4G, USB-A, USB-C) and each opens the tools that port can use.

- NETSCN: address, gateway and its maker, DNS, latency to the gateway and the internet, Wi-Fi channel, signal and encryption, and whether the network sends you to a captive portal.
- SUBSCN: every device on your subnet, shown on a radar as it answers, with names (DNS, mDNS, NetBIOS), makers and a guess at what each one is.
- PRTSCN: open TCP ports on a device and what each service says about itself.
- PRTANL: each open port explained in plain words, with a risk rating and advice.
- AIRSCN: nearby Wi-Fi networks with channel, signal, authentication and cipher, and a warning for open or WEP networks.
- LIVE: traffic graph and this device's own connections.
- USBSCN: what is plugged into a USB port (type, driver, speed, power). A Wi-Fi dongle opens its own network tools by itself.
- PCLINK / KEYB: with a PC on the device port, the CardputerZero can type into it as a USB keyboard.

Only private networks you are on are scanned, gently (plain TCP connections, no raw packets, no root). The Wi-Fi list is the normal scan every device makes. Sound effects are off until you press M. Arrows: F X Z C (no Fn needed).
